newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soybeans drop further late on fund selling.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soybeans drop further late on fund selling.

text.p: CBOT soybean futures fell further in late dealings on fund selling and on bearish input from U.S. Midwest weather, traders said.
U.S. soybean seeding has been proceeding at a rapid pace and the market viewed weather conditions as nearly ideal for soybean production.
Refco Inc and ING Derivatives each sold four million bushels of July and Rosenthal Collins sold five million bushels of July, traders said.
At 1250 CDT, soybeans were three to 12 cents a bushel lower, with July down 13 at $8.53.
